patches.value: For every t>0, e(·,t) is Lebesgue integrable. For every t>0 there exist a finite closed interval J=[s₀,s₁]⊂(0,∞) with s₀<t<s₁ and a compact set C⊂ℝⁿ such that, for every s∈J and x∉C, u(x,s)=q, ∂_s u(x,s)=0, and ∂_{x_j}u(x,s)=0 for every j∈Fin n; for every s∈J, the maps x↦u_t(x,s), x↦∂_{x_j}u(x,s), x↦e(x,s), and x↦e_t(x,s) are continuous on ℝⁿ and vanish for every x∉C, for each j∈Fin n. The ambient measurable space on ℝⁿ is the Borel σ-algebra generated by its Euclidean topology, and every compact K⊂ℝⁿ is Borel measurable with finite Lebesgue measure μ(K)<∞.
